ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 75% high-intensity white pixels and 25% low-intensity black pixels concentrated at the perimeter and midline.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous black patches at the median notch and along the trailing edges of both lobes. Smaller, discrete black punctate blobs and one prominent vertical dark streak on the interior left lobe are mapped within the white regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with a deep, sharp vertex dividing the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations along the entire trailing edge boundary, creating a jagged, non-linear profile against the background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curve extending from the median notch toward the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of dark, textured, irregular circular marks concentrated at the far lateral tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several thin, dark linear marks visible on the white field of both lobes, including a vertical streak on the left lobe and diagonal marks on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy irregular tissue accretion or barnacle scarring on the distal tips of both lobes; several dark spots and streaks that disrupt the uniform white pigmentation.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinct 'I-shaped' dark mark centrally located on the left lobe and a group of small punctate dots in the lower-left white region.
